sentences.en: Methods 15 cases of vesicovaginal fistulas were reviewed retrospectively.

sentences.en: Methods:Clinical data of 11 cases of patients with vesicovaginal fistula complicated with ureterovaginal fistula were analyzed retrospectively.

sentences.en: Methods: The clinic data of 23 cases of vesicovaginal fistula were retrospectively analyzed from year 1995 to 2005.
sentences.vi: Phương pháp: Dữ liệu phòng khám về 23 trường hợp lỗ rò âm đạo được phân tích hồi cứu từ năm 1995 đến 2005.
